glossary.Jev Router: No dedicated CONTEXT.md entry, predates this Spec and remains defined by accepted ADR-0218 with ADR-0234 credit/relay supplement; selection meaning unchanged.
glossary.Judge Log: Existing model-the-service-reported meaning remains valid; schema unchanged and read back by judge.ReadMonth in tests.
glossary.Fallback Chain: Before-Agent-work-only boundary unchanged, confirmed on both sides for both refusal reasons.
glossary.User Config: Across-repositories scope remains valid; project-floor ignored by public CLI.
glossary.credit floor: A numerical gate setting under Jev Router, not a new actor/lifecycle/domain object; guide and ADR-0234 define it. No separate glossary term needed.
glossary.relay: A private transport mechanism of an Agent Session, not a public domain object. ADR-0234 defines lifecycle; no separate glossary term needed.
